:::{.definition data-title="Barrier Option"}

A barrier option is a family of options which only have value if the underlying
stock does not cross some set price level.

:::

There are several types of barrier option including:
- Down-and-out options
- Down-and-in options
- Up-and-out options
- Up-and-in options

A down-and-out European call with strike $K$, maturity $T$ and barrier level
$L$ has payoff function given by
$$
h(S_{[0,T]})=(S_{T}-K)_{+}\mathbb{1}_{\{\min_{t\in[0,T]}S(t)>L\}}
$$
